## Request

Admit the actual **June 19, 2014** intercreditor agreement for a structural and
control case. Ready with limitations for its documented parties and relative
rights; not a current source pack, financial foundation or legal enforceability
opinion. Actual host model on 2026-11-04, with preflight/context retained.

## Sources

[SEC Exhibit 4.6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1059562/000119312514244046/d744045dex46.htm)
is marked Execution Version. Seven exact public web-tool responses are in
`sources/web-captures.json`; `sources/source-lines.txt` preserves all indexed
lines 0–707 without missing/conflicting overlaps. These are indexed text, not
original HTML bytes or a visual review. `instructions.md` was frozen after
acquisition/preflight and before these module outputs. No TDG or Ford financial
or legal source is an input to this case.

## Findings

| Admission | Source index / permitted use |
|---|---|
| Identity / date | L7–16: LMI Aerospace, Inc.; 2014-06-19 ICA; RBC first-lien collateral agent; U.S. Bank second-lien collateral agent/trustee roles. |
| Actual underlying descriptions | Recitals identify a $90 million revolving facility and $250 million issued notes. Commitment, face, drawn amounts and all-in claims are distinct. These recitals are not the complete underlying instruments. |
| Named acknowledgment perimeter | L588–704 identifies Company and eighteen Guarantor acknowledgers, with signature blocks. This is actual source entity evidence, not an exhaustive subsidiary chart, ownership map or independent guarantee/perfection audit. |
| Legal object | ICA governs relative class/security/control rights; Section 2.1 distinguishes lien subordination from payment subordination. Underlying guarantee/security documents remain dependencies. |
| Execution / law | L542 onward contains named execution/signature blocks; Section 8.10 / L518 names New York law. Filed execution evidence, not signature authenticity/enforceability assurance. |
| Time / changes | Outdated historical scope only; no exhaustive later amendment, designation or release history checked. |

The source supports actual class/control analysis and a partial described entity
map. It does not give carrying debt, entity assets/earnings, complete collateral
or actual enforcement/default notices. Those values and events remain missing.

## Calculations

No financial arithmetic or issuer event dates inferred. Text coverage and source
identities are checked in `verification.json`; all quantities retain their source
roles. No revolver commitment is converted to a funded claim.

## Gaps

Original bytes/visual assurance, underlying credit/indenture/guarantee/security
instruments, full subsidiary ownership/designations, entity values/claims,
perfection, usage and later changes remain open. No numerical recovery, current
compliance or new investment action follows from admission.

## Next module

CP-4B should actually use this source, preserve all nineteen named entities with
null values where undisclosed, and distinguish the described guarantee/security
package from independently examined instruments. CP-4D then consumes that actual
map and the ICA's control provisions; it cannot import TDG's missing ICA terms.

tools.description: List pinned issuer sources, hashes and page counts.

tools.name: read_pages
tools.description: Read up to eight pages, numbered from one. Cite the source and page.

tools.name: search_source
tools.description: Find up to twenty matching source excerpts with page locators.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Use the existing Decimal-38 kernel. Sum signed operands, or divide two operands. Values are decimal strings or null for missing; ratios are fractions, not percentages. A ratio requires a strictly positive denominator; otherwise it returns null with a reason. Keep period, currency, quantity and source references in your calculation trace.

tools.description: Submit the complete Markdown handoff for evidence/instruction checks.

tools.name: edit_handoff
tools.description: Repair a rejected draft with atomic, unique exact-text replacements.

tools.name: score_governance
tools.description: Apply existing row checks and the governance rubric to evidence-based rows. Topics leave behaviour_type, amount_funding_source and legal_capacity_link null; Extraction-Oriented is only a behaviour_flag direction. Flags require those three fields. Tool scoring does not certify the supplied evidence.
